title: Classic Optimized
description: Classic Optimized is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to deliver maximum FPS and ultra-smooth gameplay without unnecessary mods. Perfect for low-end PCs and players who just want pure performance.
body:
Classic Optimized is a carefully optimized Minecraft modpack built for players who want the best possible performance without sacrificing stability.

This modpack focuses on:
🚀 High FPS boost using top-tier optimization mods like Sodium

⚡ Fast loading times & smooth gameplay

🧩 Minimal & essential mods only (no bloat)

💻 Perfect for low-end and mid-range PCs

Whether you're exploring, building, or playing survival, Classic Optimized ensures a lag-free experience with consistent performance.
